Assists or Assisted Kills <title refill [G_refill] /> 66% of the Magazine.
Can only activate once before needing a manual reload.

Magazine can overflow, and is always rounded up.

Assists on targets previously hit by the Weapon or Assisted Kills with the Weapon <title refill [G_refill] /> 66% of the Magazine from reserves. 

The refill can overflow the magazine and the refill amount is always rounded up to a whole number.

Can only activate once before needing a manual reload.

Assists on targets previously hit by the Weapon or Assisted Kills with the Weapon <title refill [G_refill] /> 66% of the Magazine from reserves and increase Reload Speed. 

The refill can overflow the magazine and the refill amount is always rounded up to a whole number.

Can only activate once before needing a manual reload.

Once per reload, ally kills on targets previously hit by the Weapon or Kills on targets damaged by allies grant the following benefits:
• Loads 66% of the Magazine Capacity (rounded up) into the weapon from reserves (this can overfill the Magazine)
• Grants ? Reload Speed

Bows receive ?% decreased Draw Time instead of the above benefits.
